Package com.tangosol.coherence.rest

Class RestQueryPolicy

  • java.lang.Object
    • com.tangosol.coherence.rest.RestQueryPolicy
  • public final class RestQueryPolicy
extends Object
    Central hardening-aware policy for REST direct query input.

    Keeps HTTP direct query behind one gate and one strict parse/validate/build path so SSE and non-SSE resources cannot diverge.

    Since:
    26.04
    Author:
    Vaso Putica 2026.05.08
